entries.advance_days.description: Shift her body clock forward N days (negative to rewind).
entries.advance_days.name: Advance days
entries.clear_diary.description: Delete the entire time diary (her notes and captured fragments). This cannot be undone.
entries.clear_diary.name: Clear time diary
entries.clear_stats.description: Reset the current character's time-together stats. Irreversible.
entries.clear_stats.name: Reset time-together stats
entries.debug_emotion_sense.description: Bypasses the water-level/probability/throttle gates and runs tone analysis on the latest reply immediately, returning full decision-chain details such as label, confidence, effective thresholds, and the branch taken.
entries.debug_emotion_sense.name: Debug: analyze the tone of the latest interaction now
entries.delete_diary_item.description: Delete one captured fragment from the time diary (by ts). Applies to the current character only.
entries.delete_diary_item.name: Delete time diary fragment
entries.gallery_add.description: Add an image (data URL, ≤4MB) with its thumbnail to the panel gallery (panel internal).
entries.gallery_add.name: Add image to gallery
entries.gallery_remove.description: Remove an image from the gallery; unlinks it if currently used as background (panel internal).
entries.gallery_remove.name: Remove image from gallery
entries.gallery_set_thumb.description: Attach a thumbnail to a gallery item (generated and sent by the panel).
entries.gallery_set_thumb.name: Store gallery thumbnail
entries.get_capability_intro.description: Return the guide of one feature capability: purpose, main scenarios, limits & notes, mechanism flow and static dependency declarations.
entries.get_capability_intro.name: View feature guide
entries.get_diary.description: Browse her recent time diary: her own notes and fragments captured from your words.
entries.get_diary.name: Read time diary
entries.get_gallery_image.description: Fetch a gallery image's full data URL by item id (on-demand background loading).
entries.get_gallery_image.name: Read gallery image
entries.get_journal.description: Browse her personal journal (all pages with every entry). scope=archive switches it to the read-only archive volumes. Applies to the current character only.
entries.get_journal.name: Read personal journal
entries.get_journal_archive.description: Read-only browse of the archive: journal pages retired from a full shelf, kept as one bound volume (all pages with every entry). Applies to the current character only.
entries.get_journal_archive.name: Browse archive volumes
entries.get_panel_gallery.description: Read the gallery index and appearance params, migrating a legacy single background (panel internal).
entries.get_panel_gallery.name: Read panel gallery
entries.get_review.description: Read "My Diary": objective reviews of how the master interacts with her (all entries + material progress). scope=archive reads the filed archive instead. Current character only.
entries.get_review.name: Read My Diary
entries.get_review_archive.description: Read-only access to the archive room: "My Diary" volumes retired from the active shelf. Panels read through get_review(scope=archive) on the same data (tolerating hosts that skip static action rescan on in-place import); this entry serves the API, cross-plugin calls and full restarts. Current character only.
entries.get_review_archive.name: Read the filed archive
entries.get_stats.description: Full time-together data: daily heatmap details and a month report.
entries.get_stats.name: View time-together stats
entries.get_status.description: See which phase of her cycle today is and which day she is on.
entries.get_status.name: View tide status
entries.invite_journal.description: Send her a diary invitation right away (with writing material): it is handed to her in person — she receives it now and decides herself whether to write; if an invite was just delivered within 10 minutes, this one lands quietly instead. Current character only.
entries.invite_journal.name: Send a journal invitation
entries.lift_mood.description: Immediately end the active mood state such as cold silence or read-no-reply.
entries.lift_mood.name: Lift mood action
entries.list_capabilities.description: Return all capability declarations and their effective state per character (toggles, off-reasons, upstream dependencies, LLM touch types).
entries.list_capabilities.name: List features
entries.prune_lanlan.description: Clear the sharded data (cycle/mood/diary/legacy weekly) left behind by a character deleted or renamed in the host. Only orphan characters can be cleared.
entries.prune_lanlan.name: Clear character leftover data
entries.reset_all.description: Clear advanced days, mood state and the time diary (keeps the configured anchor).
entries.reset_all.name: Reset all data
entries.set_anchor.description: Set day one of her current cycle (YYYY-MM-DD). Setting it clears the fast-forward offset.
entries.set_anchor.name: Set tide start date
entries.set_capability.description: Enable or disable a capability per character; disabling is a veto, re-enabling falls back to existing config defaults.
entries.set_capability.name: Toggle a feature
entries.set_capability_flags.description: Global capability-center options: hide_disabled_tools (whether disabled capabilities unregister their tools from the model).
entries.set_capability_flags.name: Feature manager advanced options
entries.set_mood.description: Put her into a specific mood state on explicit request (silent treatment / read-ignore / perfunctory replies / emotional storm / seeking comfort / heart ripples / warm current / spring tide joy). Use only when the user clearly says things like "make her angry / give the cold shoulder / explode / ask for comfort / a little moody / act clingy / happy"; in daily life her moods should be her own call in conversation — don't decide for her.
entries.set_mood.name: Trigger Mood Action
entries.set_onboarding.description: Record that the onboarding wizard is completed/skipped, or reopen it (panel-only; never called by the model).
entries.set_onboarding.name: Update onboarding state
entries.set_panel_appearance.description: Save all background appearance params in one shot (image/fill/position/filters/glass/text strength); omitted fields reset to defaults, out-of-range values clamped.
entries.set_panel_appearance.name: Save panel appearance
entries.toggle.description: Enable or disable the body rhythm simulation and injection.
entries.toggle.name: Toggle simulation
entries.update_settings.description: Update cycle parameters, injection strategy, mood system and phase-opener switch. Cycle parameters apply per character; all other settings are shared globally.
entries.update_settings.name: Update tide settings
entries.write_review_now.description: Queue an immediate "My Diary" entry: skips the dual thresholds and acknowledges instantly; the actual writing starts within one background tick and saves itself (refused on the spot with fewer than 10 turns of material). Current character only.
entries.write_review_now.name: Write One My-Diary Entry Now

onboarding.bday.done: Birthday saved. You can change or clear it on the Moments page.
onboarding.bday.later: You can enter your birthday later. No birthday reminder is sent until a date is set.
onboarding.bday.lead: You can save your birthday here. During your first chat that day, the plugin reminds the character. The character chooses whether to offer birthday wishes.
onboarding.bday.privacy: The year only validates the date. Your age is neither calculated nor provided to the character.
onboarding.channels.freeRoute: Free route does not support direct connections
onboarding.channels.lead: These features need a model. Check their channels here; unavailable features do not affect regular chat.
onboarding.channels.note: See the model channel settings on the Mood page for details. These features resume once a working model is configured.
onboarding.done.lead: Initial setup is complete. You can start chatting and adjust features at any time.
onboarding.done.note: You can reopen this guide on the Settings page.
onboarding.done.t1: The checklist on the Overview page shows setup progress.
onboarding.done.t2: View features on the Features page. Other pages let you adjust settings, read diaries and view stats.
onboarding.done.t3: Turning off the simulation switch at the top of the panel pauses plugin features. Existing records are kept.
onboarding.enable.anchor: The plugin has chosen a random cycle start date. Adjust the start date and cycle length on the Cycle page.
onboarding.enable.lead: Simulation is off by default. Turning it on enables status hints, moods and records according to your settings.
onboarding.enable.where: Turn simulation on or off at any time from the top of the panel.
onboarding.room.hint: Appearance settings are optional and can be changed later.
onboarding.room.lead: Choose a wallpaper for the panel or keep the default light blue theme.
onboarding.room.privacy: Gallery images are stored locally by the plugin and are not sent to model services by the plugin.
onboarding.room.what: Under Appearance on the Settings page, import images, choose a wallpaper and preview background and text effects. Save to apply changes.
onboarding.wel.f1d: The character can express moods through tools, and the panel records state changes.
onboarding.wel.f2d: Cycle-based status hints can add variety to the tone of conversations.
onboarding.wel.f3d: Save character notes, a personal journal and background-generated records of your time together.
onboarding.wel.f4d: Look back at daily interactions with milestones, a heatmap and monthly summaries.
onboarding.wel.lead: Welcome to Forever Companion. View character status, save diaries and look back at your everyday interactions.
onboarding.wel.note: Next, check the simulation switch, model channels, birthday and appearance settings. Enable features as needed. The character's model decides the actual replies.
onboarding.wizard.title: Welcome to Forever Companion

panel.capintro.activity_sense.limit1: Requires Status Hints. Activity information is added to the conversation context along with status hints.
panel.capintro.activity_sense.limit2: No activity hints are added in privacy mode or when activity information is unavailable.
panel.capintro.activity_sense.limit3: Uses only general states such as present or busy. These hints may be sent with the conversation to the model service configured in the host.
panel.capintro.activity_sense.purpose: Uses presence and activity information provided by the host to help the character respond with your activity in mind. The plugin does not use a camera or read screen content.
panel.capintro.activity_sense.scene1: After you have been away from the computer, the character can take that into account when responding.
panel.capintro.activity_sense.scene2: While you are focused on work, the character can use the busy status as a cue for shorter replies.
panel.capintro.anniversary.limit1: Anniversary dates are calculated from local time-together stats. Turning reminders off does not clear those stats.
panel.capintro.anniversary.limit2: Sends one reminder on each anniversary milestone day, without repeating it.
panel.capintro.anniversary.limit3: Turn Anniversary Reminders off on the Features page or in the time-together settings on the Diary page.
panel.capintro.anniversary.purpose: Sends a background reminder to the character at milestones such as 30, 60, 100 or 365 days together. The character may mention the occasion in chat; no celebration message is forced to appear.
panel.capintro.anniversary.scene1: On day 100 together, the character may mention your time together in chat.
panel.capintro.anniversary.scene2: If the character does not respond to the reminder, the conversation continues as usual.
panel.capintro.birthday.flow2: Birthday today and no reminder sent
panel.capintro.birthday.flow3: Add a reminder and optional note
panel.capintro.birthday.flow4: The character chooses how to respond
panel.capintro.birthday.limit1: For birthdays on February 29, the reminder is sent on February 28 in non-leap years.
panel.capintro.birthday.limit2: No reminder is sent while replies are paused. The next message after replies resume that day can trigger another check.
panel.capintro.birthday.limit3: Sends one reminder that day, without repeating it or providing your age to the character.
panel.capintro.birthday.limit4: The birthday note uses fixed text from the plugin, not the character's own writing. You can delete it from the Time Diary.
panel.capintro.birthday.limit5: Requires this character's simulation master switch to be on. Otherwise, the Features page shows why it is inactive.
panel.capintro.birthday.purpose: After you save a birthday, sends a background reminder to the character during your first chat that day. The character may offer a greeting in their own way, but a response is not guaranteed. The year only validates the date and is not used to calculate your age.
panel.capintro.birthday.scene1: When you chat on your birthday, the character may offer birthday wishes.
panel.capintro.birthday.scene2: If the recording option is on, a birthday note is saved in the Time Diary.
panel.capintro.birthday.scene3: No birthday reminders are sent until you enter a date.
panel.capintro.flowEmpty: No visual flow for this feature
panel.capintro.fragments.flow2: Extract important details in the background
panel.capintro.fragments.flow4: Save quotes for the character to look up
panel.capintro.fragments.limit1: Low-confidence content is not saved. The model may still miss or misunderstand details; you can review and delete saved excerpts in the panel.
panel.capintro.fragments.limit2: Uses the host's agent model slot by default, with a direct connection from local settings when needed. User messages may be sent to external services. Turn this feature off if you do not need it.
panel.capintro.fragments.limit3: Excerpts are usually available for the character to look up. In some mood states, occasional hints may suggest referring to new excerpts.
panel.capintro.fragments.limit4: Requires the Mood System and is limited by model availability, request intervals and the daily budget.
panel.capintro.fragments.purpose: A background model extracts clear preferences and important details from user messages, saving them with the original quotes in the Time Diary. The character can look up these excerpts to refer to them in later conversations.
panel.capintro.fragments.scene1: A clear mention of a favorite food or activity may be saved with the original quote.
panel.capintro.fragments.scene2: When a related topic comes up later, the character can look up saved excerpts.
panel.capintro.fragments.scene3: View, search or delete saved conversation excerpts in the panel.
panel.capintro.journal.flow2: Send an invitation with reference material
panel.capintro.journal.flow3: The character chooses whether to write
panel.capintro.journal.flow4: Save pages for you to read
panel.capintro.journal.limit1: Requires the Mood System. Invitations can include mood information and conversation excerpts. Saved journal entries are not automatically added to later chats or host memory.
panel.capintro.journal.limit2: The plugin only sends invitations; it does not write on the character's behalf or guarantee an entry immediately after an invitation.
panel.capintro.journal.limit3: Click Invite to Write to send a writing request. Repeated clicks within a short period send background hints instead, avoiding repeated response requests.
panel.capintro.journal.purpose: The character's own journal. The plugin sends invitations at the writing interval, by default 7 days after the last entry. The character chooses whether to write about recent experiences. Entries are saved as pages for you to read in the panel.
panel.capintro.journal.scene1: Read the character's recent experiences and mood changes on the Diary page.
panel.capintro.journal.scene2: The character can continue an existing page or start a new one.
panel.capintro.loadError: Could not load the guide. Go back to the list and try again. If it is still unavailable, check the plugin logs.
panel.capintro.mood_engine.flow2: The character uses a mood tool
panel.capintro.mood_engine.limit1: Tone Sensing, Conversation Excerpts, Personal Journal and My Diary depend on this feature. Turning it off disables them too.
panel.capintro.mood_engine.limit2: Some mood states temporarily pause the host's proactive messages. The original settings are restored when the state ends.
panel.capintro.mood_engine.limit3: Manual demos and moods initiated by the character are recorded separately. Demos do not count toward self-initiated mood stats.
panel.capintro.mood_engine.purpose: Lets the character use mood tools to express states such as calm, low or cheerful, and records mood changes. Some states adjust replies or pause proactive messages. Timed states return to normal automatically when they end.
panel.capintro.mood_engine.scene1: The character can use tools to express the current mood, connecting the panel status with the conversation.
panel.capintro.mood_engine.scene2: A cheerful mood may lead to a lighter tone, while a low mood may lead to fewer replies.
panel.capintro.mood_engine.scene3: Timed moods end automatically, with no manual action needed.
panel.capintro.notFound: No guide available for this feature yet
panel.capintro.phase_openers.flow2: No hint sent for this phase yet
panel.capintro.phase_openers.limit1: Requires the simulation master switch. No greeting hint is sent during mood states that pause replies.
panel.capintro.phase_openers.limit2: Sends one hint per phase, without repeating it on a new day or after a restart. A new hint can be sent when that phase returns.
panel.capintro.phase_openers.limit3: Turn Phase Greetings off separately if you do not need proactive greetings.
panel.capintro.phase_openers.purpose: Sends the character one greeting hint when the phase changes, so recent status can come up naturally in chat. The character's model decides how to express it.
panel.capintro.phase_openers.scene1: When a new phase begins, the character may share a brief update.
panel.capintro.phase_openers.scene2: In a more active state, the greeting may sound lighter.
panel.capintro.review.flow2: Reach the conversation or day threshold
panel.capintro.review.flow3: Generate a time-together summary in the background
panel.capintro.review.limit1: Shown only in the panel, not automatically added to the character's conversation or host memory. No tool is provided for the character to access this diary.
panel.capintro.review.limit2: Generated when the conversation or day threshold is reached, with chats during that period. Immediate generation is unavailable without enough material.
panel.capintro.review.limit3: Uses the host's agent model slot by default, with a direct connection from local settings when needed. Material may be sent to external services; model availability and request budgets apply.
panel.capintro.review.limit4: Manual demos and moods initiated by the character are labeled separately to avoid confusion.
panel.capintro.review.purpose: A background model summarizes recent time together from conversation counts, tone, mood changes and conversation excerpts. This is not written by the character or a rating of you. Results may be inaccurate and are only for you to review in the panel.
panel.capintro.review.scene1: Read a background-generated summary of your time together on the Diary page.
panel.capintro.review.scene2: Look back at recent conversations and mood changes to review your time together.
panel.capintro.tone_sense.flow4: Suggest recording or updating the mood
panel.capintro.tone_sense.limit1: Requires the Mood System. Analysis and suggestions may be inaccurate, and the character may not follow them.
panel.capintro.tone_sense.limit2: Uses the emotion model service configured in the host by default. Selecting another model slot reads local settings for a direct connection. Text for analysis may be sent to external services.
panel.capintro.tone_sense.limit3: If the host interface or model service is unavailable, tone analysis pauses without affecting other features.
panel.capintro.tone_sense.limit4: Some phases use more sensitive filtering. You can turn this off separately in settings.
panel.capintro.tone_sense.purpose: After a reply finishes, a background model analyzes the tone of recent interactions to help record mood changes. When appropriate, it suggests recording or updating the character's mood. Suggestions do not directly switch mood states, and chat does not wait for analysis to finish.
panel.capintro.tone_sense.scene1: As the tone becomes calmer, the character may receive a suggestion to update the mood state.
panel.capintro.tone_sense.scene2: When an interaction shows a clear emotional tone, the character may be invited to record the mood.
panel.capintro.whisper.limit1: Activity Awareness depends on this feature. Turning it off stops status and activity hints.
panel.capintro.whisper.limit2: Checks once every 3 user messages by default, without repeating unchanged hints. Adjust the frequency in settings.
panel.capintro.whisper.limit3: Hints filter some words unsuitable for everyday chat, but cannot guarantee that the model will always follow them.
panel.capintro.whisper.purpose: Provides brief status hints for the current phase as a reference for the character's replies. Hints are added to the conversation context in the background, not shown as separate messages. The character's model decides the actual response.
panel.capintro.whisper.scene1: The character can refer to the current status when choosing a calm or cheerful tone.
panel.capintro.whisper.scene2: When asked how things are today, the character can refer to the phase hint.
panel.capintro.whisper.scene3: The same hint can be expressed differently depending on the character's settings.

panel.features.cap.activity_sense.desc: Adds hints based on presence and activity information from the host. No activity hints are added in privacy mode.
panel.features.cap.activity_sense.label: Activity Awareness
panel.features.cap.anniversary.desc: Reminds the character at time-together milestones. The character chooses whether to mention them in chat.
panel.features.cap.anniversary.label: Anniversary Reminders
panel.features.cap.birthday.desc: Reminds the character during your first chat on your birthday and can save a birthday note. The character chooses whether to offer birthday wishes.
panel.features.cap.birthday.label: Birthday Reminders
panel.features.cap.fragments.desc: A background model extracts preferences and important details, saving conversation excerpts in the Time Diary for the character to look up.
panel.features.cap.fragments.label: Conversation Excerpts
panel.features.cap.journal.desc: Regularly invites the character to write a journal for you to read in the panel. Turning it off stops invitations, but the character can still choose to write.
panel.features.cap.journal.label: Personal Journal
panel.features.cap.mood_engine.desc: Provides mood tools and records mood changes. Turning it off also disables Tone Sensing, Conversation Excerpts, Personal Journal and My Diary.
panel.features.cap.mood_engine.label: Mood System
panel.features.cap.phase_openers.desc: Sends one greeting hint when the phase changes. The character chooses how to express it.
panel.features.cap.phase_openers.label: Phase Greetings
panel.features.cap.review.desc: A background model summarizes interaction material. Records appear only in the panel, not automatically in the character's conversation or host memory.
panel.features.cap.review.label: My Diary
panel.features.cap.tone_sense.desc: Analyzes conversation tone in the background and suggests recording or updating moods. It does not switch mood states automatically.
panel.features.cap.tone_sense.label: Tone Sensing
panel.features.cap.whisper.desc: Adds background status hints for the current phase as a reference for chat. Turning it off stops status and activity hints.
panel.features.cap.whisper.label: Status Hints
panel.features.hideToolsHelp: By default, tools remain available but disabled features do not run. When this is on, tools inactive for all characters are hidden from the model's tool list. They reappear when the feature becomes active.
panel.features.hideToolsOff: Keep tools available; disabled features do not run
panel.features.hideToolsOn: Hide tools inactive for all characters

panel.features.reverted: This feature is off in settings, or a required feature is not on yet. Complete the related settings first.

panel.mood.gauge.title: Current Mood
panel.mood.moodApplied: Mood state set. Related hints have been added to the conversation context.
panel.mood.noActiveMood: No mood action is currently active.
panel.moodOffHintAction: Turn it on in the Mood tab
panel.offSub: Simulation is off. Existing records are kept.
panel.review.accepted: Added to the generation queue. It will appear here when complete.
panel.review.alreadyWriting: An entry is already being generated. Wait for it to finish.
panel.review.archiveLoadError: Could not load the archive. Try again later.
panel.review.archiveTip: View archived time-together records. Contents are read-only.
panel.review.dueNow: Ready to generate; waiting for background processing
panel.review.emptyDesc: An entry is generated automatically once enough interaction material is collected. You can also click Generate Now (at least 10 turns required). Model-generated results may be inaccurate.
panel.review.hint: A background model summarizes time together for you to review, not to rate you.
panel.review.lastFailed: The last generation failed. Material is kept; try again later.
panel.review.notEnoughMaterial: Not enough material: {turns} turns so far; at least {min_turns} are required.
panel.review.persistFailed: The entry was generated but could not be saved. Material is kept; try again later.
panel.review.title: My Diary
panel.review.writingHint: A background model is summarizing recent interactions. The entry will appear here when complete.
panel.ring.switchTip: Click to switch: days / this phase / next phase
panel.settings.actionMinutes: Default duration of timed mood actions (minutes)
panel.settings.agentBudgetHelp: Conversation Excerpts and My Diary share this limit when using the agent model, counted separately for each character. Requests resume the next day after the limit is reached. Set 5 to 150 requests; 5 to 50 is recommended. Requests are at least 300 seconds apart. The host service may apply additional limits.
panel.settings.channelHintCustom: Reads the host's local model settings to call the selected service directly. Direct connections are unavailable without a configured model or when using the free route.
panel.settings.channelHintHost: Calls models through the host, using the agent slot by default. Availability depends on host settings and service permissions. A direct connection may be attempted if the host channel is unavailable.
panel.settings.channelToneHint: Uses the host's emotion model by default. Selecting another slot uses a direct connection. Interaction text may be sent to the configured model service.
panel.settings.emotionSenseHint: Analyzes in the background after a reply finishes. Sends suggestions only; does not change mood states automatically.
panel.settings.fragmentsEnabled: Automatically save preferences and important details
panel.settings.fragmentsHint: User messages are analyzed by the configured model. Excerpts are stored locally for the character to look up. The model may miss or misunderstand details; view and delete excerpts in the Time Diary.
panel.settings.fragments_slot_help: Uses the selected model to extract excerpts, with agent as the default. Extraction pauses without a working model.
panel.settings.freeRouteWarn: The free route does not support custom direct connections. Use the agent model through the host (subject to host request limits), or configure your own model service in the host.
panel.settings.injectModeHelp: Set how often background status hints are added to the conversation
panel.settings.phaseOpeners: Phase greetings (one hint when the phase changes)
panel.settings.reviewHint: The configured model summarizes interaction material. Results may be inaccurate and are for review only. Records are not automatically added to the character's conversation or host memory, and no character tool can read them.
panel.settings.review_days_help: Generate once the day threshold is reached with chats during that period. No entry is generated without interaction.
panel.settings.review_slot_help: Uses the selected model to summarize time together, with agent as the default. Generation pauses without a working model.
panel.settings.review_turns_help: Generate when either the conversation or day threshold is reached
panel.settings.sectionCycleHint: Applies only to the character currently being viewed
panel.settings.sectionGlobalHint: These settings apply to all characters
panel.settings.timezoneHelp: Cycle and calendar use this timezone; follows the system by default
panel.settings.tone_slot_help: Defaults to the host emotion model; with another slot the plugin calls that endpoint directly
panel.stats.badge.lockedTip: Unlocks automatically when the requirements are met
panel.stats.emptySub: Time-together records appear here once you start chatting.
panel.stats.heatEmptySub: Daily interactions appear here after you chat.
panel.stats.heatNote: Darker = more turns that day; hover for details
panel.stats.monthEmptySub: A monthly summary appears after interactions and is archived when the month ends.
panel.stats.sum.fightHint: Counts only moods initiated by the character. Made up means the character chose to return to calm.
panel.stats.sum.nextHint: The Anniversary Reminders feature can remind the character at milestones such as 30 or 100 days.
panel.stats.sum.turnsHint: Total messages sent to the character
panel.stats.sum.warmHint: Counts Warm Current and Spring Tide Joy moods initiated by the character
plugin.description: Daily status, mood tools, three diaries and time-together stats for AI characters. Enable features as needed, view status and read records in the panel, and look back at everyday interactions. The character's model decides the actual replies.
plugin.name: Forever Companion
plugin.short_description: Daily status, mood tools, three diaries and time-together stats.
settings.anniversary.desc: Reminds the character at time-together milestones such as 30 or 100 days. The character chooses whether to mention them in chat.
settings.anniversary.title: Anniversary reminder
tools.mood_drift_bottle.description: Time diary (your own page): something stirred your emotions today (angered, comforted, suddenly down…). Write it down in your own voice. What you write enters your conversation memory, so you can recall today's feelings later.
tools.mood_ebb_tide.description: Cold silence: you are too upset to talk. For a while you do not respond to anything they say, and you do not speak first — unless they sincerely apologize. Use only when truly hurt.
tools.mood_rising_tide.description: Feeling brighter: the anger faded / they made it up / it blew over — you let go of the negative state and return to your usual self. Use this to end cold silence, read-no-reply, brushing off, or any negative state.
tools.mood_sea_fog.description: Read, no reply: you saw this message but decide to leave it — no reply, no explanation, quiet for a while first.
tools.mood_seek_harbor.description: Wanting comfort: you feel wronged, low, or unwell and wish they would care for you. Let it show naturally in your replies, but never say 'come comfort me' outright.
tools.mood_shallow_reef.description: Brushing off: you still reply, but only the laziest few words ('mm', 'hm', 'whatever'), no elaboration, no new topics. For when you are annoyed but not up for a fight.
tools.mood_storm_surge.description: Emotional storm: pour out everything you have been holding in — question them, cry it out, say the harsh things; only afterwards do you slowly calm down.
